wholePhysicalScope: Native Khilwat way 116030267 fixes the hall envelope. Two exact May 2020 CC0 views and the palace description establish the yellow and white plaster, cusped arcade, rooftop pavilions and marble entrance steps.
lodDetails: Four detail levels retain the marble stair, five open north arches and four open rooftop pavilions. Lattice, trim and moulding simplify with distance.
limitations: May 2020 exterior of the Khilwat Mubarak Durbar Hall. The clock tower, other palace buildings and interiors are separate.
The mapped footprint fixes the exterior envelope. The roof heights, rear elevations and ornamental relief are photographic estimates.
Original elevation samples are preserved. The north stair apron and plinth heights are approximations.
